en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2771 - Al-Nadr narrated from Shu‘ayb al-‘Aqarqufi, who said:

I and Hadid set out until we reached the orchard on the Day of Tarwiyah. I went ahead on a donkey, arrived in Mecca, performed tawaf and sa‘i, exited my ihram from tamattu‘, and entered ihram for Hajj. Hadid arrived later that night. I wrote to Abu al-Hasan (as), seeking guidance regarding his situation.
Imam (as) wrote back to me: "Instruct him to perform tawaf, sa‘i, exit his ihram from tamattu‘, then enter ihram for Hajj, join the people in Mina, and ensure he does not spend the night in Mecca."
